standard-dialogue.npc: Oh dear! Oh dear! I don't have time to chat!

opening-bedroom-door-without-priest-gown.npc: Please leave my husband alone. He's very sick, and I don't want anyone bothering him.

opening-bedroom-door-without-priest-gown.player: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?

opening-bedroom-door-without-priest-gown.npc: Thank you, but I just want him to see a priest.
